caption: 🥣 5-Minute Breakfast for You & Your Little One 🍌✨ Simple, cozy, and perfect for busy mornings! • 1 cup whole milk • ½ cup rolled oats • Dash of cinnamon • ½ banana Cook ~3-5 mins on low/medium heat until creamy, then let your little one choose their favorite fruit toppings 🍓🫐 Want to make your bowl extra fun? I topped mine with chia seeds, walnuts, strawberries, and a drizzle of honey 🍯. Same oatmeal, different toppings = happy breakfast for everyone! Quick, nutritious, and ready in 5 minutes ❤️ #easyrecipe #momrecipes❤️ #toddlerbreakfast #toddlermeals #toddlermealideas
